name: Abony Acquisition Corp. I
summary: Abony Acquisition Corp. I functions as a Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC), essentially a shell corporation. Its core mission is to execute a strategic business combination, which may encompass a merger, an exchange of capital stock, the acquisition of assets, a stock purchase, a corporate reorganization, or comparable transactions involving one or more target entities. The company was established on November 13, 2025, and its principal offices are located in Austin, Texas.
